name: Stand Fast
description: If the unit did not move this turn: +1 GRD and +10 avoid until the next phase.

name: Presence
description: Allies within 2 tiles: +5 accuracy, +5 avoid.

name: Command
description: Allies within 3 tiles: +10 accuracy, +10 avoid (replaces Presence).

name: Clemency
description: Each non-boss enemy this unit defeats adds 30 dinars of ransom to the chapter reward.

name: Shield Wall
description: Adjacent allies gain +1 GRD (does not stack).

name: Bulwark
description: Takes 2 less damage from physical attacks (never below 0).

name: Highlander
description: Hills and crags cost 1; +10 avoid on them.

name: Phalanx
description: +1 GRD for each adjacent ally wielding a spear (max +3).

name: Counter-Charge
description: Counterattacks against Mounted units always hit and gain +3 Might.

name: Parry
description: +10 avoid when defending against a melee attack.

name: Keen Edge
description: +15 crit with sabres and daggers.

name: Last Stand
description: Below 25% HP: +15 avoid and +10 crit.

name: Heavy Blow
description: +2 Might against targets with lower BLD.

name: Sunder
description: A hit lowers the target's GRD by 1 until the end of the next phase (stacks to -3).

name: Warcry
description: At the start of its phase, allies within 2 tiles gain +2 MGT for that phase.

name: Steady Aim
description: +10 accuracy with bows and crossbows if the unit did not move.

name: Long Draw
description: Bow range +1 (max 4) if the unit did not move.

name: Deadeye
description: +20 crit with bows.

name: Wheel
description: After attacking (not countering) move up to 2 tiles.

name: Swift
description: +1 MOV.

name: Skirmish
description: As Wheel, up to 3 tiles.

name: Shock
description: +2 Might when attacking after moving at least 4 tiles this turn.

name: Pursuit
description: After defeating an enemy, move up to 2 tiles (once per turn).

name: Piercing Bolt
description: Crossbows gain +1 Pierce.

name: Bolt Volley
description: +3 Might with crossbows against Armored or Mounted targets.

name: Siege Bolt
description: Crossbows deal double Might against structures.

name: Elusive
description: +10 avoid.

name: Harry
description: A unit this unit hits loses 10 avoid until the end of the phase.

name: Lightstep
description: All passable terrain costs 1.

name: Ignite
description: Fire attacks leave flames on the target tile.

name: Wildfire
description: Ignite also starts flames on one adjacent flammable tile.

name: Fire Storm
description: Fire attacks also strike one adjacent enemy of the target for half damage.

name: Sap
description: Action: deal 8 damage to an adjacent wall or gate; at 0 it becomes a breach.

name: Entrench
description: Action: place a barricade on an adjacent empty tile (3 per chapter).

name: Mend
description: Action: restore 10 uses to an adjacent ally's weapon (once per turn).

name: Triage
description: Remedies heal 3 more if the target is below 50% HP.

name: Cure
description: Remedies also clear Thirst, Heat and Burning.

name: Renewal
description: Adjacent allies regain 5 HP at the start of the unit's phase.

name: Counsel
description: Action: one ally within 3 gains +10 accuracy and +10 avoid until the end of the next enemy phase.

name: Dispatch
description: Action: an ally within 2 acts again (once per turn; not on Lords).

name: Decree
description: Action, once per chapter: all allies gain +10 accuracy and +10 avoid until the end of the next enemy phase.
